text: Testing plays a vital role in creating reliable software. Unit tests check small, individual parts of the code, like a single function. This helps developers catch mistakes early. After that, integration tests make sure different parts of the system work together smoothly. For many teams, test-driven development (TDD) is a useful practice. In TDD, you write a failing test first, then write the code to pass it. This approach guides the design and keeps the focus on what the code should do. Above all, having a solid suite of tests gives developers confidence. They can change or improve their code without constant fear of breaking something, which makes the entire project healthier.
